title: Distribute Candies Among Children I
summary: Given positive integers n and limit, calculate the number of ways to distribute n candies among 3 children with each child receiving no more than limit candies.
statement: Given positive integers n and limit, calculate the number of ways to distribute n candies among 3 children with each child receiving no more than limit candies.
constraints: Distribute exactly n identical candies among three labeled children.
Each child must receive between zero and limit candies inclusive.
Return the number of ordered distributions.
hints: Choose amounts for the first two labeled children.
Their choices force the third amount to n-first-second.
Count the pair exactly when the forced amount lies from zero through limit.
Every valid ordered triple has one unique first/second pair, so the enumeration counts it once.
editorial: Every valid ordered triple has one unique first/second pair, so the enumeration counts it once.

tests.explanation: Only the three permutations of (1,2,2) meet the limit.
There are ten nonnegative ordered triples summing to three.
